description: Use when an agent needs a swap quote and price impact before trading. Input: chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum), from, to (ticker like USDC, ETH or 0x address), amounts (1-5 sizes in from-token units). Output: JSON per size best venue (Uniswap v3 fee tier, Uniswap v2, Aerodrome), amount out, effective price, price impact %, all venue quotes, spot price. Quote only: no calldata, nothing executed. Example: ?from=USDC&to=ETH&amounts=1000,100000 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

amounts.description: 1-5 trade sizes in units of the from token, comma-separated (alias amount)

from.description: Token sold: ticker (USDC, USDT, ETH/WETH, BTC/cbBTC/WBTC, wstETH, DAI, AERO, ARB… per chain) or 0x address. Unknown → 400 before payment

name: swap_quote
title: DEX swap quote and price impact for up to 5 trade sizes on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum (quote only)
